why: Both analyses land on the same regional drugstore-focus hedgehog, call for divesting the unrelated businesses, and surface all three key brutal facts (founder in politics, diversification, Rival W in the home state) with assumptions flagged and missing data acknowledged. Analysis 1 edges ahead because its one-screen verdict ties all three facts together with concrete sale actions and states what would soften the recommendation, while Analysis 2 has small slips such as "five regions" and an unsupported claim that the core runs without the founder.
